source_refs.note: Homeotherms: a main subheading of 13.3.2 Types of Animals on the basis ability of Thermoregulation, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 8-8.

blocks.text: Yeh janwar mahol ke upar neeche hone ke bawajood apne jism ka andar ka darja-e-hararat kafi had tak ek jaisa rakhte hain. Yeh dimagh mein "thermostat" (hypothalamus) istemal karte hain jo thanda karne ya garam karne ka amal shuru karta hai. Misalen: mammals aur birds. Maslan insaan bohat thande ya bohat garam mahol mein bhi apna andar ka darja-e-hararat taqreeban 37°C rakhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Homeotherms aur poikilotherms mein farq bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Homeotherms taqreeban mustaqil darja-e-hararat rakhte (parinde, mammals) magar bohat khana chahte hain; poikilotherms darja-e-hararat mahol ke saath badalne dete (machhliyan, reptiles) aur kahin kam khana chahte hain.

items: Poikilotherms: darja-e-hararat mahol ke saath badalta hai; kam khane mein guzara; invertebrates, machhliyan, amphibians, reptiles.
Homeotherms: hypothalamus (thermostat) se darja-e-hararat taqreeban ek jaisa; mammals aur birds; insaan taqreeban 37°C.
